decisions.reason: The black-finish range is a surface variant of the firm's core drainage technology, so it can use existing manufacturing know-how and read market feedback easily, though as a trend-driven finish line it is only mentioned on the website.
A shower channel for seamless coverings builds directly on the firm's deep drainage expertise and its barrier-free bathroom strategy, and its dedicated web page signals commitment.

The pump-assisted solution extends the firm's knowledge into pump technology, where its absorptive capacity is thinner, but in-house R&D and its fit with renovation and barrier-free needs justify keeping it while the firm learns.
A tileable floor drain with grating is very close to the established offer, fully interpretable with existing know-how, and presented on its own page.
A stainless steel design grate is a core competence of a metal-fabricating drainage specialist and fits its design-led positioning, with low risk and easy learning from results.
